content_html:
guard.py — stop it from touching the files that matter

CLAUDE.md is advice. The model reads it, the conversation gets long, the rule loses priority, and it edits the file anyway.

That is not a prompting problem. No wording fixes it.

This is not advice. It runs before the tool call and refuses it.

Blocked by guard.py: .env
It matches the pattern '.env' listed in .claude/protected.txt.

The model never gets to write. It gets told why, and moves on.

Install (2 minutes)

mkdir -p .claude
curl -o .claude/guard.py        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/guard.py
curl -o .claude/protected.txt   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/protected.txt
curl -o .claude/settings.json   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/settings.json

Already have a .claude/settings.json? Merge this in instead of overwriting:

{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit",
        "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "python3 .claude/guard.py" }]
      }
    ]
  }
}

On Windows use python instead of python3.

Restart Claude Code. That's it — no dependencies, Python 3.8+.

Choose what to protect

Edit .claude/protected.txt. One pattern per line.

.env
.env.*
*.pem
*.key
credentials.json

migrations/**
legacy/**

.claude/guard.py
.claude/protected.txt
.claude/settings.json

A bare filename matches anywhere in the tree, because that's what you mean when you type it. .env blocks ./.env and api/.env both. dir/** blocks everything under that directory.

Keep the last three lines. They are what stops the model from disabling its own guard when it gets stuck.

Check it works

echo '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":".env"},"cwd":"'"$PWD"'"}' | python3 .claude/guard.py; echo "exit=$?"

exit=2 means it's live. exit=0 on a protected path means the pattern didn't match.

What it does and doesn't do

Does

  • Blocks Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit on paths you list
  • Reads every path in a MultiEdit batch, not just the first
  • Returns the reason on stderr, so the model stops instead of retrying
  • Fails open — if the hook itself errors, your work continues. A guard that breaks everything when it breaks is worse than no guard.

Doesn't

  • Doesn't block Bash. rm -rf still goes through — see below.
  • Doesn't protect against a user who edits protected.txt themselves. It's a guardrail, not a permission system.

Bash is a separate problem — bash_guard.py

guard.py only sees Edit/Write. git reset --hard goes through Bash and sails straight past it. That gap is how people lose hours.

A report filed this week: the model ran git checkout -- inside a shell loop it wrote itself, the loop's own guard clause never engaged, and every uncommitted file in the repo went with it. Unstaged changes have no reflog and no stash.

The unrecoverable set is short enough to just gate:

git checkout --   git reset --hard   git clean -f
git restore       git push --force   rm -rf

curl -o .claude/bash_guard.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/bash_guard.py
{ "matcher": "Bash",
  "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "python3 .claude/bash_guard.py" }] }

Two choices worth copying if you write your own:

Scan the whole command string. The dangerous call is rarely the first token — it's inside a loop or behind an &&. Anything checking argv[0] misses it.

Only list what's genuinely irreversible. git reset --soft, git clean -n and --force-with-lease stay allowed. A guard that fires on safe variants gets switched off within a day, and then you have nothing.

It names the reversible alternative in the refusal, because a bare "denied" gets you a model that retries with sh -c:

Blocked by bash_guard.py: git checkout --
This discards uncommitted changes in the working tree, with no reflog and no stash.
Use this instead: git stash push -- <paths>

Why a hook and not a rule

Where it lives When it loses
CLAUDE.md in the prompt context gets long, priority drops
hook in your machine never — it isn't the model's decision

Rules are advisory. Hooks are enforcement. Use both: CLAUDE.md for why, guard.py for can't.

What this doesn't solve

A hook can only stop things that end in a tool call. It can't stop the model from continuing after you told it to stop, or from reporting work as done that it never verified, or from confidently proposing the approach you already tried and abandoned.

Those are the failures that actually cost you a week, and they need a different kind of fix — a rules file that carries why, a session boundary before the window rots, and a habit of asking for evidence instead of accepting "Done!".

The main README covers those. Free, and the useful half for most people.

If you want the long version, there's a 25-page field manual — $19 — with approval gates, kill switches, cost control, when not to build an autonomous loop, 7 copy-paste templates, and a chapter on not fooling yourself about results.

Don't buy it if you already design your own hooks and subagents. You wrote this script yourself in your head while reading it.

Part of claude-code-survival-kr — rules and prompts that stop AI from breaking working code. MIT.

It matches the pattern '.env' listed in .claude/protected.txt.

模型永远无法写入。 它被告知原因，然后继续前进。

安装（2 分钟）

mkdir -p .claude
curl -o .claude/guard.py        https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/guard.py
curl -o .claude/protected.txt   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/protected.txt
curl -o .claude/settings.json   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/settings.json

已经有 .claude/settings.json 了？ 将其合并而不是覆盖：

{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit",
        "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "python3 .claude/guard.py" }]
      }
    ]
  }
}

在 Windows 上使用 python 而不是 python3。

重新启动克劳德代码。 就是这样——没有依赖项，Python 3.8+。

选择要保护的内容

编辑.claude/protected.txt。 每行一个图案。

.env
.env.*
*.pem
*.key
credentials.json

migrations/**
legacy/**

.claude/guard.py
.claude/protected.txt
.claude/settings.json

裸文件名与树中的任何位置匹配，因为这就是您键入它时的意思。 .env 会阻止 ./.env 和 api/.env 两者。 dir/** 阻止该目录下的所有内容。

保留最后三行。 它们可以阻止模型在卡住时禁用自己的防护。

检查是否有效

echo '{"tool_name":"Edit","tool_input":{"file_path":".env"},"cwd":"'"$PWD"'"}' | python3 .claude/guard.py; echo "exit=$?"

exit=2 表示它处于活动状态。 受保护路径上的 exit=0 表示模式不匹配。

它做什么和不做什么

Does

  • 阻止您列出的路径上的编辑、写入、多重编辑、笔记本编辑
  • 读取 MultiEdit 批次中的每个路径，而不仅仅是第一个
  • 在 stderr 上返回原因，因此模型停止而不是重试
  • 打开失败 - 如果钩子本身出错，您的工作将继续。 一个守卫一旦破坏就破坏一切，这比没有守卫更糟糕。

没有

  • 不会阻止 Bash。 rm -rf 仍然会执行 - 见下文。
  • 不能防止用户自行编辑 protected.txt。 这是一个护栏，而不是一个许可系统。

Bash 是一个单独的问题 — bash_guard.py

Guard.py 只能看到编辑/写入。 git reset --hard 遍历 Bash 并直接绕过它。 这种差距就是人们损失时间的原因。

本周提交的一份报告：该模型运行 git checkout - 在它自己编写的 shell 循环内，循环自己的保护子句从未参与，并且存储库中的每个未提交的文件都随之而来。 未暂存的更改没有重新记录，也没有存储。

不可恢复的集合足够短，只需门控即可：

git checkout --   git reset --hard   git clean -f
git restore       git push --force   rm -rf

curl -o .claude/bash_guard.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/avenna01-ceo/claude-code-survival-kr/main/guard/bash_guard.py
{ "matcher": "Bash",
  "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "python3 .claude/bash_guard.py" }] }

如果您自己编写，则有两个值得复制的选择：

扫描整个命令字符串。 危险的调用很少是第一个标记——它位于循环内部或 && 后面。 任何检查 argv[0] 的内容都会错过它。

只列出真正不可逆转的事情。 git reset --soft、git clean -n 和 --force-with-lease 保持允许。 向安全变体开火的守卫会在一天之内关闭，然后你就一无所有了。

它在拒绝中命名了可逆的替代方案，因为裸露的“拒绝”会为您提供一个使用 sh -c 重试的模型：

Blocked by bash_guard.py: git checkout --
This discards uncommitted changes in the working tree, with no reflog and no stash.
Use this instead: git stash push -- <paths>

为什么是钩子而不是规则

它住在哪里 当它失去的时候
CLAUDE.md 在提示中 上下文变长，优先级下降
hook 在你的机器上 永远不会——这不是模型的决定

规则是建议性的。 挂钩是强制执行。 使用两者：CLAUDE.md 表示原因，guard.py 表示不能。

这不能解决什么问题

钩子只能停止以工具调用结束的事情。 它无法阻止模型在您告诉其停止后继续运行，或者报告从未验证过的已完成工作，或者自信地提出您已经尝试过但放弃的方法。

这些失败实际上会让你花费一周的时间，它们需要一种不同的修复方法——一个包含原因的规则文件，一个窗口失效之前的会话边界，以及一个要求证据而不是接受“完成！”的习惯。

主要自述文件涵盖了这些内容。 免费，而且对大多数人来说有用的一半。

如果你想要长版本，有一本 25 页的现场手册——19 美元——包括批准门、终止开关、成本控制、何时不构建自主循环、7 个复制粘贴模板，以及关于不要在结果上欺骗自己的一章。

如果您已经设计了自己的钩子和子代理，请不要购买它。 您在阅读该脚本时自己在脑海中编写了该脚本。

claude-code-survival-kr 的一部分 — 阻止人工智能破坏工作代码的规则和提示。 和。
